how_to_apply: Ensure you are registered on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) 2.0 Portal.
Visit the official NATS 2.0 application link: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and bank details.
Upload the required category/relaxation certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), if applicable.
Enter the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying Degree/Diploma examination (convert CGPA to percentage using the institution's approved formula, if required).
Ensure your Aadhaar-seeded bank account is DBT-enabled, as per Government of India norms.
Submit the application on or before 09.09.2026.

important_instructions: Applicant eligibility will be assessed strictly based on the information provided in the online application form. Furnishing false or wrong information will lead to rejection/cancellation/termination of candidature or apprenticeship. The apprenticeship does not confer any right to claim employment at IIIT Bhagalpur, and the Institute has no liability to provide any job to apprentices after completion of training. No request for change of date/time/venue of document verification will be considered under any circumstances. It is mandatory to appear in person for document verification; failure to do so will result in rejection of candidature. No accommodation or travel allowance will be provided to apprentices at IIIT Bhagalpur. The Apprenticeship contract will be executed with the Regional Apprenticeship Advisor, Board of Apprenticeship Training (ER), Kolkata, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961. The apprenticeship period is 12 months from the date of joining, after which the contract terminates automatically. All correspondence will be through email only; applicants should regularly check their email, including the spam folder, and the Institute website for updates. IIIT Bhagalpur reserves the right to reject any or all applications, amend any clause, or increase/decrease/postpone/cancel the engagement process without assigning any reason. Any dispute arising out of this recruitment will be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated in Bhagalpur.

Candidates holding a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, Commerce, or Arts can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Diploma Government Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more apprenticeship opportunities can also explore the latest Bihar Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to Bhagalpur can check Bhagalpur Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Department-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 21 vacancies are available - 3 for Computer Science and Engineering, 3 for Electronics & Communication Engineering, 3 for Mechatronics & Automation Engineering, 2 for Mathematics & Computing, 2 for Library, 1 for Finance & Accounts, 2 for Computer Centre/Website Management, 3 for Administration and 2 for Store & Purchase. Reservation for these posts will be applicable as per Government of India norms. The notification does not specify a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) breakup for individual posts.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The gap between the last date of application (09.09.2026) and the passing date of the qualifying degree/diploma examination should not be more than two years. Applicants who have already registered for, undergone, or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act elsewhere are not eligible to apply. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply for this apprenticeship program.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 25 years Age reckoning date: 09.09.2026 Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. Upper age relaxation will be applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates as per Government of India guidelines. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS applicants claiming age relaxation must upload the necessary certificates while filling the online application form and produce the original certificates at the time of document verification. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must be issued after 01.04.2026 in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice 2026 Stipend/Salary Structure
content_sections.text: No other payment shall be made to apprentices apart from the consolidated stipend mentioned above.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Ensure you are registered on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) 2.0 Portal. Visit the official NATS 2.0 application link: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and bank details. Upload the required category/relaxation certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), if applicable. Enter the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying Degree/Diploma examination (convert CGPA to percentage using the institution's approved formula, if required). Ensure your Aadhaar-seeded bank account is DBT-enabled, as per Government of India norms. Submit the application on or before 09.09.2026. Applications will be accepted only through the NATS 2.0 portal. No other mode of application will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The shortlisting and engagement of apprentices will be based solely on merit, i.e., the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying Degree/Diploma examination as claimed by the applicant in the application form, along with mandatory eligibility criteria. In case of a tie in percentage marks between two or more applicants, preference will be given to the applicant senior in age. If the tie persists even after applying the above criterion, the decision will be taken by the competent authority. Provisionally shortlisted applicants will be called for document verification on a specified date, time, and venue. Joining is subject to successful verification of original documents and a medical fitness certificate from a Government Hospital.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice 2026 Required Documents for Verification
content_sections.text: Applicants shortlisted for document verification must carry the following documents in original along with one set of self-attested photocopies: Print-out of the online application form submitted on the NATS 2.0 portal Print-out of the page showing Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled bank account status Class X mark sheet or certificate indicating date of birth Qualifying Diploma/Graduation mark sheet and certificate showing date/month/year of passing Caste category certificate, wherever applicable OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate (issued after 01.04.2026), wherever applicable PwBD category certificate, wherever applicable Aadhaar Card Medical fitness certificate from a Government Hospital Percentage conversion certificate from the university (if the qualifying result is in CGPA)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online through the NATS 2.0 portal is 09.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 21 apprenticeship posts are available across nine departments, including Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechatronics & Automation Engineering, Mathematics & Computing, Library, Finance & Accounts, Computer Centre/Website Management, Administration, and Store & Purchase.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for IIIT Bhagalpur apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices (Degree Holders) will receive Rs 12,300/- per month, while Technician Apprentices will receive Rs 10,900/- per month. No other payment is made to apprentices.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applicant's minimum age should be 18 years and maximum age should not exceed 25 years as on 09.09.2026, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. How to apply for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online through the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php between 21.08.2026 and 09.09.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee. This information is not available in the official document.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIIT Bhagalpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based purely on merit, i.e., the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying Degree/Diploma examination, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Will apprentices get a job at IIIT Bhagalpur after completing the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. The notification clearly states that apprentices have no right to claim employment at IIIT Bhagalpur based on their apprenticeship, and the Institute has no liability to offer any job after completion of training.
